resources.contents:
openapi: "3.0.0"

info:
  title: Edubit API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: OpenAPI spec for Edubit's workshops
  contact:
    name: HMCA

tags:
  - name: Users
    description: All operations related with Users

components:
  schemas:
    TransientParticipant:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
          format: password
        grade:
          type: integer
        activities:
          type: object
          format: JSON
        parentEmail:
          type: string
          format: email
        parentPhone:
          type: integer
      required:
        - name
        - email
        - password
        - parentEmail
        - parentPhone
    PersistentParticipant:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        roles:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        parentEmail:
          type: string
          format: email
        parentPhone:
          type: integer
        activities:
          type: string
          format: JSON
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - name
        - email
        - roles
        - parentEmail
        - parentPhone
        - enabled
        - creationDate
    TransientMentor:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
          format: password
        phone:
          type: integer
      required:
        - name
        - email
        - password
        - phone
    PersistentMentor:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: UUID
        roles:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        phone:
          type: integer
        activities:
          type: object
          format: JSON
        enabled:
          type: boolean
        creationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        modificationDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
        disabledDate:
          type: string
          format: ISO 8601
      required:
        - id
        - roles
        - name
        - email
        - phone
        - enabled
        - creationDate
    AuthorizationToken:
      type: object
      properties:
        token:
          type: string
          format: JSON token
    ConfirmChangePasswordRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        newPassword:
          type: string
          format: password
        token:
          type: string
          format: integer

servers:
  - url: https://{gateway}.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/{stage}/users
    description: URL on AWS cloud
    variables:
      gateway:
        enum: [mj8c3yqni8]
        default: mj8c3yqni8
      stage:
        enum: [dev, qa, live]
        default: dev

paths:
  /signup:
    post:
      summary: Sign up participant
      description: Creates a user with PARTICIPANT role, registering email and password on AWS Cognito
      operationId: createUserAsParticipant
      tags:
        - Users
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransientParticipant'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User successfully created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentParticipant'
        '409':
          description: User already created
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /signup/mentor:
    post:
      summary: Sign up mentor
      description: Creates a user with MENTOR role, registering email and password on AWS Cognito
      operationId: createUserAsMentor
      tags:
        - Users
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TransientMentor'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User successfully created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentMentor'
        '409':
          description: User already created
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
        '502':
          description: Unprocessable request
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /login:
    post:
      summary: Log in
      description: Authenticates a user against Cognito and obtains a JSON toke
      operationId: login
      tags:
        - Users
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                password:
                  type: string
                  format: password
              
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authorization token issued
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthorizationToken'
        '400':
          description: Wrong credentials, Not authorized, User not found or User not confirmed
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /password/change:
    post:
      summary: Change password
      description: Initiates the change password flow, requesting the change to AWS Cognito
      operationId: changeUserPassword
      tags:
        - Users
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Change password token successfully sent
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  message:
                    type: string
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
  /password/change/confirm:
    post:
      summary: Confirm password change
      description: Confirms the password change, making the change in AWS Cognito
      operationId: confirmChangeUserPassword
      tags:
        - Users
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ConfirmChangePasswordRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Password change confirmed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PersistentParticipant'
        '500':
          description: Internal server error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                  type: object
